doc: Mentor golden set (W2-EVAL). German and English learner questions with graded VALUES: dates, EUR amounts, percentages, cited fact ids, a refusal with its link, a labelled 'not officially confirmed'. Every expected value is printed in the verified facts the case cites (content/mentor-facts); scripts/mentor-eval.mjs --lint proves that. as_of pins the clock so 'next window' expectations never flip. Learner messages here are test inputs, not shipped copy. Dates here are test expectations, not claims (check-dates: run it with ':!tests/**' like the other fixtures).
